item.title: Cyberattack on healthcare provider exposes patient medical records
item.description:
A healthcare organization has identified unauthorized access to systems responsible for processing patient information.
The incident resulted in potential exposure of sensitive medical information including medical documentation, diagnostic information, appointment history and patient contact details.
The intrusion affected systems supporting patient services and medical data processing. Investigation of the initial access vector and affected infrastructure remains ongoing.
The incident is being tracked under reference REF-Q7M4K2VX91.
Organizations evaluating exposure to this incident should retain the reference identifier in internal security notifications and incident reporting.
